import {
  MeshStandardNodeMaterial,
  MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial,
  MeshBasicNodeMaterial,
} from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec3, mix, smoothstep, step, add, float, color as tslColor } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const THREE = ctx.THREE;
  const root = new THREE.Group();
  root.name = 'bento-metrics-grid';

  const geometries = [];
  const materials = [];
  const timelines = [];
  const primHandles = [];

  const spec = config.intent?.visualSpec ?? {};
  const colors = spec.colors ?? {};
  const C = {
    background: colors.background ?? '#0b0b10', // color.background
    surface: colors.surface ?? '#14141a',       // color.surface
    ink: colors.ink ?? '#16161d',               // color.ink
    paper: colors.paper ?? '#e8ecf2',           // color.paper
    accent: colors.accent ?? '#ff2a38',         // color.accent
    grad0: colors.gradientStops?.[0]?.hex ?? '#101017',
    grad1: colors.gradientStops?.[1]?.hex ?? '#1a1a22',
  };

  // ---------- backdropStage: graded stage plane, never a void ----------
  function backdropStage() {
    const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(7, 6);
    geometries.push(geo);
    const mat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
    const g0 = vec3(...hexToLin(C.background));
    const g1 = vec3(...hexToLin(C.grad1));
    // vertical gradient with subtle center lift so no flat #000 region
    const v = uv().y;
    const lift = smoothstep(0.15, 0.75, v).mul(0.85).add(smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, uv().x.sub(0.5).abs().oneMinus()).mul(0.15));
    mat.colorNode = mix(g0, g1, lift);
    materials.push(mat);
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
    mesh.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);
    root.add(mesh);
  }

  function hexToLin(hex) {
    const c = new THREE.Color(hex);
    return [c.r, c.g, c.b];
  }

  // ---------- lightRig: rig-tech-clinical ----------
  function lightRig() {
    const amb = new THREE.AmbientLight('#e6e9ee', 0.34);
    root.add(amb);
    const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#f2f4f6', 1.2); // scene provides key 1.2; local trim below ceiling
    key.position.set(1.6, 3, 2.6);
    key.target.position.set(0, 0.4, 0);
    root.add(key, key.target);
    const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#e6e9ee', 1.0);
    fill.position.set(-2, 2.4, 2.2);
    fill.target.position.set(0, 0.4, 0);
    root.add(fill, fill.target);
    const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#ffffff', 0.8);
    rim.position.set(0, 2, -3);
    rim.target.position.set(0, 0.5, 0);
    root.add(rim, rim.target);
  }

  // ---------- slabFaceMaterial: engineered diagonal gradient + machined sheen band ----------
  function slabFaceMaterial() {
    const mat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({ roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0.35 });
    const g0 = vec3(...hexToLin(C.grad0));
    const g1 = vec3(...hexToLin(C.grad1));
    // 135-degree diagonal coordinate
    const d = uv().x.add(uv().y.oneMinus()).mul(0.5);
    let col = mix(g0, g1, d);
    // hard-stop machined sheen band ~0.15u wide at 40%, +6% value
    const band = step(0.4, d).mul(step(d, float(0.47)));
    col = mix(col, col.add(vec3(0.06, 0.06, 0.065)), band);
    mat.colorNode = col;
    materials.push(mat);
    return mat;
  }

  // ---------- chamferFrameMaterial: brushed metal edge ----------
  function chamferFrameMaterial() {
    const mat = new MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color(C.ink),
      roughness: 0.5,
      metalness: 0.45,
      clearcoat: 0.2,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.35,

    materials.push(mat);
    return mat;

    geometries.push(geo);
    const mat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color(C.accent),
      emissive: new THREE.Color(C.accent),
      emissiveIntensity: 1.3,

    materials.push(mat);

    geometries.push(frameGeo);
    const frame = new THREE.Mesh(frameGeo, chamferFrameMaterial());
    frame.position.z = 0;
    cell.add(frame);

    geometries.push(faceGeo);
    const face = new THREE.Mesh(faceGeo, slabFaceMaterial());
    face.position.z = 0.035;

  const heroLblTxt = t[2] ?? 'Case tolerance, CNC pass';
  const v2Txt = t[3] ?? '38 h';
  const l2Txt = t[4] ?? 'Power reserve, NA-01';

  addText(topCell, v2Txt, { fontSize: 68, color: C.paper, align: 'left' }, -1 + 0.5, 0.05);
  addText(topCell, l2Txt, { fontSize: 18, color: '#9aa2ad', align: 'left', letterSpacingPx: 1.4 }, -1 + 0.5, -0.35);
  addText(botCell, v3Txt, { fontSize: 68, color: C.paper, align: 'left' }, -1 + 0.5, 0.05);

  (function contactShadow() {

  const cells = [domCell, topCell, botCell];

    pointerdown: () => pressCell(domCell),
    click: () => ctx.emit('metric-select', { id: 'case-tolerance' }),
  };

  root.userData.cleanup = () => {
    timelines.forEach((tl) => tl.kill());
    primHandles.forEach((h) => h?.cleanup?.());
    geometries.forEach((g) => g.dispose());
    materials.forEach((m) => m.dispose());
  };

}
